text.tspan: "The product line needs a vehicle network that carries the driving command from the central computer to an actuation ECU on CAN and keeps, on each of two routes, the properties that the model asks of the command paths of earlier increments."
"The command source on the central computer gives driving commands, and the Eclipse S-CORE path hands each one to the vehicle network."

"On each route a command that reaches the actuation ECU whole is applied to the vehicle, a command that is lost, delayed, repeated or corrupted on its way is detected and not applied, and when no valid command reaches the actuation the vehicle gets the stop response."
Operate the vehicle network without selecting the medium of the direct
